definitions.explanation: A group of people related by blood, marriage, or adoption living together.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{旅行|りょこう}しました。
ご{家族|かぞく}はお{元気|げんき}ですか？お{父|とう}さんにもよろしくお{伝|つた}えください。
examples.english: Is your family well? Please give my regards to your father too.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{家族|かぞく}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}って、みんなで{食事|しょくじ}をするのが{楽|たの}しみです。
examples.english: On weekends, I look forward to cooking with my family and eating together.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{家族|かぞく}を{大切|たいせつ}にする{人|ひと}で、{毎週|まいしゅう}{日曜日|にちようび}は{仕事|しごと}をしないで{家族|かぞく}と{過|す}ごすと{決|き}めています。
examples.english: He is a person who values his family and has decided not to work on Sundays but to spend them with his family.

notes:
{家族|かぞく} is the standard word for family—the group of people related by blood, marriage, or adoption.

POLITENESS:
- {家族|かぞく}: my family (neutral)
- ご{家族|かぞく}: your/someone's family (polite)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {家族|かぞく}は〜{人|にん}です: My family has ~ people
- {家族|かぞく}と{一緒|いっしょ}に: together with family
- {家族|かぞく}を{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value one's family

RELATED TERMS:
- {親|おや}: parent(s)
- {父|ちち}/{母|はは}: father/mother (own)
- {兄弟|きょうだい}: siblings
- {親戚|しんせき}: relatives
